_documentation.purpose: Runs the reduced optical tweezers experiment or benchmark.
_documentation.relies_on: Uses only the physics values in this file.
_documentation.authority: Values in this file are authoritative for its runner. A sweep value overrides the corresponding base-simulation value only for that named case; effective values are recorded in summary.json.

fields.domain.width_m: Sets width m; units are metres.
fields.domain.height_m: Sets height m; units are metres.
fields.bath_temperature_K: Sets bath temperature K; units are kelvin.
fields.material.critical_temperature_K: Sets critical temperature K; units are kelvin.
fields.material.coherence_length_m: Sets coherence length m; units are metres.
fields.material.penetration_depth_m: Sets penetration depth m; units are metres.
fields.material.normal_resistivity_ohm_m: Sets normal resistivity ohm m; units are metres.
fields.laser.sigma_m: Sets sigma m; units are metres.
fields.laser.thermal_response_time_s: Sets thermal response time s; units are seconds.
fields.laser.protocol[].delta_temperature_K: Sets delta temperature K; units are kelvin.
fields.laser.protocol[].time_s: Sets time s; units are seconds.
fields.laser.protocol[].x_m: Sets x m; units are metres.
fields.laser.protocol[].y_m: Sets y m; units are metres.
fields.pinning_sites[].energy_per_length_J_per_: Sets energy per length J per m; units are metres.
fields.pinning_sites[].sigma_m: Sets sigma m; units are metres.
fields.pinning_sites[].x_m: Sets x m; units are metres.
fields.pinning_sites[].y_m: Sets y m; units are metres.
fields.initial_vortices[].charge: Integer vortex winding: +1 is a vortex and -1 an antivortex.
fields.initial_vortices[].x_m: Sets x m; units are metres.
fields.initial_vortices[].y_m: Sets y m; units are metres.
fields.current_density_A_per_m2: Sets current density A per m2; units are amperes per square metre.
fields.run.duration_s: Sets duration s; units are seconds.
fields.run.dt_s: Sets dt s; units are seconds.
fields.run.sample_every: Save diagnostics every this many accepted steps.
fields.run.maximum_displacement_per_step_m: Sets maximum displacement per step m; units are metres.
fields.evaluation.transport_interval_s: Sets transport interval s; units are seconds.
fields.evaluation.maximum_following_lag_m: Sets maximum following lag m; units are metres.
fields.evaluation.destination_m: Sets destination m; units are metres.
fields.evaluation.delivery_radius_m: Sets delivery radius m; units are metres.
fields.output.directory: Base output directory; runners reserve a numbered sibling if it already exists.
